The Appcues Public API exposes programmatic access to Appcues flows,
mobile experiences, pins, launchpads, banners, checklists, embeds, NPS,
segments, users, groups, events, and offline jobs. US and EU regions are
supported. Authentication uses HTTP Basic with an API key as the username
and API secret as the password.
